period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) vs 31-Dec-2013. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2014 (for Q1, cumulative = discrete). SOLO/STANDALONE basis. SOURCE-FILENAME QUIRK: the bank's own website filed this report under the filename '1stqs_2013_Un-audited.pdf' (suggesting Q1-2013), but the document's own header, every data column ('31 MARCH 2014' / '31-DEC 2013' on the Balance Sheet; 'For the quarter ended 31 March 2014' and '1st January 2014 to 31 March 2014' vs '31-March 2013' comparative on the P&L), the Statement of Changes in Equity, the Selective Notes ('as on March 31, 2014') and the signature date ('Dhaka, 12, May 2014') all unambiguously confirm this is genuinely the quarter ended 31 March 2014, not 2013 -- a bank-side archival/filename error, not a data error. This dataset's own genuine Q1-2013 filing (found separately, under a different, correctly-dated filename) is stored as 2013_Q1.json; its own 31-March-2013 comparative figures (investment income 208,825,008; total operating income 150,938,836; PAT -3,835,670; EPS -0.006; etc.) match this Q1-2014 filing's own Mar-2013 comparative column exactly, cross-validating both documents. Source PDF is a genuine digital/text PDF (pdftotext -layout, no OCR needed). Fully cross-checked: balance-sheet identity closes (liabilities 23,710,721,496 + equity -9,526,773,846 = 14,183,947,650, matches reported total assets exactly); income statement chain closes exactly (A-B=C, C-D=PBT, PBT-tax=PAT, PAT/664,702,300 shares=EPS -0.277, matching reported). SAME DISCREPANCY as 2013_Q1.json/2013_Q3.json: this filing's own 31-Dec-2013 Total Shareholders' equity comparative (-9,342,685,151) differs from 2013_Q4.json's stored FY2013 total_equity (-9,895.57m) by ~552.9m (the bank's revaluation/other reserve) -- corroborated again by NAV per share: -9,342,685,151/664,702,300=-14.06, matching 2013_Q4.json's own already-stored nav_per_share of -14.06 exactly (whereas -9,895.57m would imply NAVPS -14.89, inconsistent with 2013_Q4.json's own field). Total assets, total deposits, gross investments and off-balance-sheet exposures in this filing's Dec-2013 comparative column all match 2013_Q4.json exactly (14,302.84m / 11,970.13m / 9,788.56m / 249.43m respectively), isolating the divergence specifically to the equity/liabilities split. 2013_Q4.json itself is left unmodified per this task's scope; see sources.json.
